preconditions.description: The number of vertices V must be between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= u < V and 0 <= v < V for edge in adj for u, v in edge)
preconditions.description: All vertices in the adjacency list must be valid indices within the range of 0 to V-1.
The adjacency list must have exactly V entries, one for each vertex.

postconditions.description: If the graph contains an Eulerian circuit, the output must be '2'.
If the graph contains an Eulerian path, the output must be '1'.
If the graph contains neither an Eulerian path nor an Eulerian circuit, the output must be '0'.
